name: publicWeb_getKennelArt
description: The app's Run art gallery for one kennel, for a web member (E9.F7.S12): every visible, live run of the kennel that has an EventImage, newest first — what QueryKennels.queryKennelGallery reads from the phone's synced events. Auth: HC6.ValidateAppAuth (spNumber 116, @param NULL); no permission gate beyond a signed-in device. Read-only.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: The browser's HC.Device id (the web member session). No SQL default.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Short-lived token signed for this SP (ValidateAppAuth spNumber 116, @param NULL). No SQL default.

parameters.name: publicKennelId
parameters.description: The kennel. No SQL default; an unknown id returns the success envelope and no rows.

rowsets.name: AuthErrorEnvelope
rowsets.description: On a ValidateAppAuth failure: { success = 0, errorCode, errorType } then the detail at index 1; the SP RETURNs.
Error detail after the AuthErrorEnvelope (errorId, errorType, errorCode, errorTitle, errorUserMessage, errorProc).

rowsets.name: Envelope
rowsets.description: On success: { success = 1, errorCode = NULL, errorType = NULL }.

rowsets.name: KennelArt
rowsets.description: On success: one row per run with IsVisible = 1, deleted = 0, removed = 0 and a non-empty EventImage, ORDER BY EventStartDatetimeGmt DESC. The kennel's own deleted/removed flags are not checked.

columns.name: EventStartDatetime
columns.description: CAST(Event.EventStartDatetime AS datetime2(7)) — the local wall-clock time with the offset dropped (see /hc-event-datetimes).

columns.name: EventStartDatetimeGmt
columns.description: Event.EventStartDatetimeGmt — the instant; the sort key.

sideEffects: INSERT HC.ErrorLog ('<web>', userId, deviceId) then THROW in the CATCH. ValidateAppAuth logs its own failures.

codeSmells.detail: @deviceId, @accessToken and @publicKennelId have no SQL default (line 13). A caller that omits one is refused by SQL Server before the procedure runs — an empty 500 with no HC.ErrorLog row (CLAUDE.md 'SP parameter with NO default'). The Next.js client always sends them, so this is latent.

codeSmells.issue: Raw EventStartDatetime used as local time
codeSmells.detail: Line 46 casts EventStartDatetime to datetime2 to get the wall clock. CLAUDE.md / /hc-event-datetimes: the raw column carries a spurious +00:00 on ~67% of rows; EventStartLocal is the canonical local-clock column. The cast happens to give the wall clock either way, but the canonical column would make the intent explicit.
The join at line 50 has no k.deleted / k.removed filter, so a removed kennel's art is still returned for its public id.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
